title: This Just In
subtitle: Silence and stillness are already the highest form of alert.

trails.title: L.A. Efficiency
trails.description: New reports, same old faces, same old work.

content.text: Guidelines from the Vigiles Bureau on Recent Arcane Violence

Based on the latest Vigiles Bureau guidelines on recent arcanum-related violence, modifications and updates have been made to warrants and relayed to enforcement departments.

Details are as follows:

Wanted: Qi Xing, code name "Nightpiercer."
Threat level raised to "A."
Last seen in Los Angeles and surrounding areas. Any local institutions encountering this individual must notify the Vigiles Bureau immediately.

Wanted: Arcana, leader of Manus Vindictae.
Threat level: Maximum.
Any arcanist who encounters this individual must avoid engagement and immediately report to the Foundation and request military assistance.
(Revoked, confirmed deceased)

Wanted: Kimberly, "Ms. Kimberly."
Threat level: B.
Capture and detain upon encounter, then await Vigiles Bureau support.
(Revoked)

Wanted: Forget Me Not, officer of Manus Vindictae.
Threat level: A+.
Capture and detain upon encounter, then immediately contact the Vigiles Bureau for support.
Additionally, submit a report to the local Foundation office when reporting to the Bureau.

items.speaker: Loggerhead
items.text: Tall Officer, are you up? I got you guys Chinese food. You must be hungry.

items.speaker: Poitier
items.text: Shh.
The two officers are both staring intently at the television screen.
The paper cups in their hands are crumpled tight.

items.speaker: Reporter
items.text: Almost 20 suspects in the holding cell were injured. Most were found unconscious at the scene and are now in critical condition at the hospital.

items.speaker: Reporter
items.text: The victims include arcane black market dealer Caster and Chicago gang leader Jason the Coyote, both of whom have since been acquitted of their crimes.
Behind the reporter, thick black smoke billows from the scene of a car accident. Flames lick at the oil spilled on the road, sending waves of searing heat into the air.

items.speaker: Medical Staff
items.text: Cameras, out of the way, out of the way! The ambulance needs to come through. We need banana bags stat, or these people could go into shock.

items.speaker: Injured Suspect I
items.text: Ah. My skin. It burns. Help, help!

items.speaker: Injured Suspect II
items.text: Whoever you are who did this, just wait and see. I'll, I'll tear you apart, you asshole!
Medical personnel shove past the journalist as they hurry over with a stretcher.
The cursing and wailing of the deranged man behind the reporter echo in the background. It sends a chill down their spines.

items.speaker: Reporter
items.text: The fire is speculated to have been started by a victim of a Nightpiercer attack who displayed signs of mental instability.

items.speaker: Reporter
items.text: At the same time, similar incidents have occurred at the Liber Street Detention Center and the Chinatown Police Station. The situations at both sites are similarly concerning.

items.speaker: Reporter
items.text: It has been reported that the Division of Arcane Affairs is considering the potential connections between these incidents. The mysterious figure behind the unresolved Nightpiercer attacks remains their top suspect.

items.speaker: Reporter
items.text: As with the previous attacks attributed to the Nightpiercer, the victims of these incidents are once again notorious criminals with extensive records.

items.speaker: Reporter
items.text: However, in light of the Nightpiercer's escalating criminal activities, support for the figure is dwindling as concerns for safety rise.

items.speaker: Reporter
items.text: In response to ongoing skepticism regarding the lack of resolution in the Nightpiercer case, Deputy Chief Elden of the Division of Arcane Affairs stated during the press conference that—
Poitier slams the power button on the remote before flicking it aside.
She yanks the IV needle from her hand and grabs her uniform from the bedside.

items.speaker: Poitier
items.text: F**k! I pass out for half a day, and Qí Xīng's already turned the city into her personal playground?

items.speaker: Poitier
items.text: Grab your stuff, rookie. We're hitting the road. Gotta find this b**ch before she kills someone.

items.speaker: Poitier
items.text: What, your feet stuck to the floor or something?
Poitier stops only when she notices Liáng still sitting motionless. Liáng purses her lips, struggling to speak under Poitier's skeptical gaze.

items.speaker: Liang Yue
items.text: Deputy Chief Elden took us off the case. It was an official order.
A few hours earlier, the L.A. office for the Division of Arcane Affairs fell into an eerie silence.

items.speaker: Deputy Chief Elden
items.text: Early this morning, Constance Scott, a staff member of the Foundation's Arcanum Containment Department, was assaulted during an illegal arcane object trade. She's still in critical condition.

items.speaker: Deputy Chief Elden
items.text: Forensic Services has confirmed that the arcane skill traces found at the scene of the attack match those left by the suspect in the ongoing Nightpiercer case.

items.speaker: Deputy Chief Elden
items.text: Thanks to Noire and our Vigiles cadet Liáng Yuè, who were both at the scene of the attack, we've been able to confirm the identity of the Nightpiercer.

items.speaker: Deputy Chief Elden
items.text: Name's Qí Xīng, a 29-year-old former movie actress from Hong Kong. She played the lead role in the Detective C07 series, where she gained a reasonable amount of fame.

items.speaker: Deputy Chief Elden
items.text: She was in a few more movies after that, but no big hits. She officially retired from acting a few years ago.

items.speaker: Deputy Chief Elden
items.text: The BAU's come to the conclusion that she's confused herself with her movie character—possibly a result of a mental imbalance caused by the setbacks in her career.

items.speaker: Deputy Chief Elden
items.text: She thinks she's the real-life C07, the hero who fights evil and cares for the weak. In short, we have a "vigilante" on our hands.

items.speaker: Deputy Chief Elden
items.text: Thanks to a minor mistake from the Foundation's Arcanum Containment Department, we also have a dangerous arcane item, a cursed film reel called Reunion of the Three Swallows, somewhere in the city.

items.speaker: Deputy Chief Elden
items.text: Liáng has confirmed that Constance Scott, the staff member who was assaulted by Qí Xīng yesterday, is the perpetrator of the theft.

items.speaker: Deputy Chief Elden
items.text: As you're all aware, there's been an explosion in mental disorders in Chinatown. We now know that their source is the cursed film reel.

items.speaker: Deputy Chief Elden
items.text: It's currently in Qí Xīng's possession, which makes her even more dangerous.

items.speaker: Deputy Chief Elden
items.text: Having learned about the history behind this arcane film, we have reason to believe that obtaining it was one of her motives.

items.speaker: Deputy Chief Elden
items.text: Since the film's been in her possession, there have been multiple assaults around the city, all matching the patterns of the Nightpiercer.

items.speaker: Deputy Chief Elden
items.text: But there's one key difference. This time, the victims all showed the same mental disorder as the victims of the film.

items.speaker: Deputy Chief Elden
items.text: We believe that the suspect is able to control the film's power to some extent, and she's using it to commit escalating crimes at a much higher frequency.

items.speaker: Deputy Chief Elden
items.text: We need to act before the situation gets out of control.

items.speaker: Deputy Chief Elden
items.text: Reinforcements from the Foundation and the Vigiles Bureau are already on the way. We will do whatever we can to protect our city before they arrive.
He pauses for a moment as he sweeps his gaze over the officers before him.

items.speaker: Deputy Chief Elden
items.text: James, Carter, I'm putting you on the case. You'll be taking direct orders from me. The rest of you stick to your posts.

items.speaker: Liang Yue
items.text: Excuse me, Deputy Chief Elden. I need to ask you something.

items.speaker: Deputy Chief Elden
items.text: I already know what it is.
Before Liáng can speak, Elden cuts her off. His tone is calmer than she expected.

items.speaker: Deputy Chief Elden
items.text: You and Poitier saw that something was going on in Chinatown and started an investigation yourselves.

items.speaker: Deputy Chief Elden
items.text: You found the culprit behind the ACD theft and stopped an assault that could've ended much worse.

items.speaker: Deputy Chief Elden
items.text: You've done a great job.
But then his tone shifts.

items.speaker: Deputy Chief Elden
items.text: But there's one key thing you failed to do. You had a chance to apprehend the Nightpiercer right then and there, but somehow she slipped through your fingers.

items.speaker: Deputy Chief Elden
items.text: According to your report and the witnesses' statements, you failed to summon your legendary beast when you confronted the suspect.

items.speaker: Deputy Chief Elden
items.text: As a result, not only did the suspect get away, but your partner sustained an avoidable injury. I need my best, most reliable officers on this case.
After a brief pause, he delivers his final verdict.

items.speaker: Deputy Chief Elden
items.text: Sorry, Liáng, but you don't make the cut. The two of you will be excluded from the operation.

items.speaker: Poitier
items.text: This is bulls**t! He can't cut us out. This is our case!

items.speaker: Poitier
items.text: No. We're doing this.

items.speaker: Loggerhead
items.text: Calm down, Ms. Po ... Ms. Potty! Even if you feel fine, the doctor said you had to stay in bed for at least a few days.

items.speaker: Poitier
items.text: The name's Poitier. And I'm fine, okay? Stop trying to—

items.speaker: Poitier
items.text: *cough*
Facts speak louder than words. Liáng gently leads Poitier back down onto the bed. This time, Poitier doesn't resist.

items.speaker: Poitier
items.text: Damn it. So what went wrong? How come your friend, Tángláng, was it?—didn't show up?

items.speaker: Liang Yue
items.text: Qiángliáng must've sensed my hesitation and refused my summon. You see, if its master can't overcome their selfish desires with an unwavering heart, it can turn on them. Father used to warn me about it.

items.speaker: Liang Yue
items.text: But that won't happen again, I promise.
Poitier narrows her eyes as she studies Liáng for a moment.

items.speaker: Poitier
items.text: Heh heh. If you say so, what're you gonna do now?
Liáng takes a deep breath.

items.speaker: Liang Yue
items.text: I'll continue with the investigation. I need to find Qí Xīng.

items.speaker: Loggerhead
items.text: What? But that angry grandpa already pulled you off the case.

items.speaker: Liang Yue
items.text: I have to do this.

items.speaker: Poitier
items.text: What for? Because of your duty to fight evil as the master of Qiángliáng?
Poitier furrows her brow. But to her surprise, Liáng shakes her head.

items.speaker: Liang Yue
items.text: I've always had two things guiding me: my duty as a member of the Liáng family and the spirit of C07.

items.speaker: Liang Yue
items.text: But now, Qiángliáng has ignored my summon, and Qí Xīng has turned out to be anything but a hero. They were once the beacons of my life, but not anymore.

items.speaker: Liang Yue
items.text: This could be a setback, yes, or, it could be an opportunity.

items.speaker: Liang Yue
items.text: For the first time in my life, I can think about what I really want without having to consider anything else.
After a brief moment of surprise, Poitier lets out a laugh.

items.speaker: Poitier
items.text: You know what, rookie, it always grinds my gears when you talk about your duty and all that stuff.

items.speaker: Poitier
items.text: But what you're saying now? I like it.

items.speaker: Liang Yue
items.text: Aren't you going to stop me?

items.speaker: Poitier
items.text: Why would I? It's our case, isn't it? There's nothing wrong with doing our job.

items.speaker: Poitier
items.text: If Elden b**ches about it, just tell him you bumped into the crook when you were strolling around the city.

items.speaker: Liang Yue
items.text: Seriously?

items.speaker: Poitier
items.text: Yeah. Nothing wrong with that, is there?

items.speaker: Poitier
items.text: So what's the game plan, huh? What're you gonna do?

items.speaker: Arcane Affairs Officer I
items.text: This scene again? They must've done a dozen takes already, right?

items.speaker: Arcane Affairs Officer II
items.text: Yeah. I'm no movie expert, but even I can tell the actor's nervous as hell.

items.speaker: Arcane Affairs Officer I
items.text: Of course, he is. Anyone would be nervous if they knew a wanted criminal could show up at any time and mess you up with arcanum.

items.speaker: Arcane Affairs Officer I
items.text: Elden tried to keep the details of the case a secret, but that director from Hong Kong told her crew about it as soon as she came back.
The two uniformed figures stand in a narrow alley in Chinatown.

They came to protect the potential target of an attack, Noire, but were politely turned away on the grounds of "disrupting filming." Now, they can only confirm the situation inside the set by peering through the slightly ajar door.

items.speaker: Arcane Affairs Officer I
items.text: I mean, I guess they have the right to know, and to run. Half of the extras got the hell out as fast as they could, and look at the other half. They're too nervous to work.

items.speaker: Arcane Affairs Officer II
items.text: I know. Hey, that's the Vigiles cadet, isn't it? What's she doing here?

items.speaker: Noire
items.text: The officers said you're here to help. Is that right?

items.speaker: Noire
items.text: Excellent. We could really use a hand right now. Come, let's get you in costume.
Noire greets her guest with her usual amiable smile.
Having reached an agreement with Liáng to cooperate in an arrest, Noire has not been charged for her illegal trading of the arcane object.
After being released from custody this morning, she immediately returned to filming.

items.speaker: Liang Yue
items.text: I'm more than happy to help, but first, I have something important to ask you.
Noire pauses.

items.speaker: Noire
items.text: Right to the point this time, I see.

items.speaker: Liang Yue
items.text: I don't think there's any need to tiptoe around each other anymore. Could you answer me directly this time?

items.speaker: Liang Yue
items.text: What happened between you, Qí Xīng, and Hé Rìjūn, the creator of Reunion of the Three Swallows?

items.speaker: Liang Yue
items.text: How did she die? Why do you and Ms. Qí Xīng both want that film? And why is she doing this?
Noire looks at Liáng, her usual smile fading slightly.

items.speaker: Noire
items.text: What do you plan to do with my answers?

items.speaker: Liang Yue
items.text: To Qí Xīng, I'm probably just another fan.

items.speaker: Liang Yue
items.text: But to me, she and her character mean something.

items.speaker: Liang Yue
items.text: I need to know why. I have to arrest her and find out the truth.

items.speaker: Liang Yue
items.text: Maybe I can still fix things, but, Ms. Noire, I need your help if I'm going to do it.
This time, Liáng says exactly what she's thinking. She holds her breath as she awaits Noire's response.

items.speaker: Noire
items.text: You mean, you want to know more about her.

items.speaker: Noire
items.text: To peek behind the scenes—learn what really happened behind all the movie magic. I told you it's not a good idea.

items.speaker: Noire
items.text: We create works not just to express ourselves, but to entertain. And when we release them to the public, we open ourselves to all kinds of commentary, whether they be sweet or bitter.

items.speaker: Noire
items.text: But the people behind the characters, behind the production, they are not for entertainment. Their lives are not fiction.

items.speaker: Liang Yue
items.text: Is that a no?

items.speaker: Noire
items.text: I haven't finished.
She raises an eyebrow, a hint of mischief growing behind her smile.

items.speaker: Noire
items.text: Though I don't advocate trying to cross the line between on and off screen, if we cast aside your relationship as fan and actress and treat you simply as individuals ...

items.speaker: Noire
items.text: Saying "I want to know more about you" sounds rather beautiful. It's touching, really.

items.speaker: Noire
items.text: I'll answer your questions, Ms. Liáng. Follow me.
